facts.why: `loadView` always answers 404 so clients fall back to tables, and no other view endpoint exists.
The server has no scan-planning endpoints (`planTableScan`, `fetchScanTasks`).
The server has no `signRequest` endpoint; it vends credentials instead.

equivalences.title: Delete rows without rewriting files
equivalences.differ: v3 writers must use deletion vectors instead of position delete files. Iceberg also has equality deletes (`iceberg.equality-deletes`), which Delta has no counterpart for.

icebergSpec.text: v2 position deletes; v3 deletion vectors

equivalences.title: Keep a column's identity across renames and drops
equivalences.differ: Delta opts in per table, by name or id; Iceberg always resolves columns by field id.

icebergSpec.text: Field ids, in every format version

equivalences.title: Lay data out for pruning
equivalences.differ: Delta partitions by column value; Iceberg partitions by a transform and can change it later.
